Row.Text: A Civ 5 Brave New World-style World Congress for Civ 6 Gathering Storm.
Reworks the World Congress to give players real agency: pick what gets proposed, broker votes directly, and make outcomes stick until repealed. Requires Gathering Storm.
Inspired by Civilization V: Brave New World.
The League of Nations has been founded by {1_HostName}.
{1_HostName} has founded the League of Nations and serves as its first Host. The world's first international congress will convene in the coming sessions.
